name: branding-logo-construction-grid-with-circles-and-pixel-measurements
title: Violet construction sheet: Sovrix symbol on a grid of overlapping circles and labelled pixel measurements
whatItIs: A violet slide with the logo at the top left, a 'Logo Construction' heading and description, and at the right a translucent lilac symbol over white grid lines and overlapping circles labelled with 12, 18 and 6 px radii and edge measurements.
whatItMeans: Precise and reassuring; showing the geometry proves the mark is engineered.
techniques: Overlay circles and lines on the symbol.
Label radii and spacings in pixels.

vocabulary.definition: Lines and circles showing how a logo is built.
A measure of a circle's size.
Two shades of the same hue.
A mark that works at any size.
